# MetLink

> MetLink is a full-service AI marketing & development agency — digital marketing, creative media, AI automation, and custom software that drives measurable revenue growth.

MetLink builds AI systems, marketing programs, and software products for ambitious businesses, from strategy through to production launch.

## Services

- [Digital Marketing](https://www.metlinkai.com/services/digital-marketing): SEO, performance marketing, social media marketing, content marketing, social media optimization, video editing and graphic designing.
- [Generative AI](https://www.metlinkai.com/services/generative-ai): custom GenAI development, GenAI integration, GenAI consulting, AI agent development, AI copilots, LLM development, and related hiring services.
- [Artificial Intelligence & ML](https://www.metlinkai.com/services/ai-ml): AI development, AI consulting, AI deployment, enterprise AI, AI chatbots, transformer models, MLOps.
- [Software Development](https://www.metlinkai.com/services/software-development): custom software, SaaS development, software consulting, UI/UX design, enterprise software, web application development, digital transformation.
- [Automation First](https://www.metlinkai.com/services/automation-first): workflow automation, AI agents & assistants, RPA & process bots, CRM & sales automation, marketing automation.

Full services index: https://www.metlinkai.com/services

## Industries

MetLink builds industry-specific AI and software solutions for: Finance, Insurance, Manufacturing, Logistics, Hospitality, Retail, Healthcare, Consumer Electronics, and Startups.

Full industries index: https://www.metlinkai.com/industries

## Automation by industry

Automation-first solutions tailored to: Restaurant & Cafe, Real Estate, Healthcare & Clinics, Education, E-Commerce & D2C, HR & Recruitment, and Finance & Accounting.
